name: New-holder retention breakout
hypothesis: After a retention interval, buy a range break when new buyers remain net holders above the defined retention threshold.
spec: Setup: New addresses that retain purchased inventory may represent stickier demand. Entry: After a retention interval, buy a range break when new buyers remain net holders above the defined retention threshold. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on cohort exit acceleration or failed breakout. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs point-in-time holder balances and wallet clustering (on-chain, not connected)
